capabilities: Render SVG progress rings next to headings with checkboxes
Update ring fill in real time as checkboxes are ticked
Customise ring size, stroke, colors, animation, and percentage label per heading level
Play a confetti burst when a heading reaches 100%
Scale rings down automatically for deeper heading levels
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The README includes a release/maintenance section aimed at contributors rather than users.
problem: Obsidian headings show no visual indication of how many checkboxes under them are completed, so you cannot see task progress at a glance.
summary: Progress-ring plugin that renders a live SVG completion ring next to any heading whose checkboxes, updating as items are ticked.
